title: The Lion King. Simba.
lines: Far away, in Africa, there is a big land with yellow grass, tall trees and a warm sun.
Lots and lots of animals live there.
Elephants, giraffes, zebras and rhinos.
The king of all the animals is a strong lion.
His name is Mufasa.
One morning there is a big party.
All the animals come to a high rock.
Because King Mufasa and Queen Sarabi have had a baby.
A little lion cub!
His name is Simba.
A wise old monkey, Rafiki, lifts Simba high into the air.
All the animals cheer and bow.
Hooray for Simba!
Simba grows up and becomes a cheerful, cheeky little lion.
He jumps, he runs and he roars.
Well, he tries to roar.
Rrrr, he squeaks.
His daddy laughs.
One day Mufasa takes Simba to the top of the rock.
Look, Simba, he says.
Everything the sun touches is our land.
One day you will be the king.
Wow, says Simba.
Then I can do whatever I want!
Mufasa shakes his big head.
A king must take care of everyone, he says.
The little ant and the big elephant.
Everything belongs together.
Simba has a best friend.
Her name is Nala.
Together they play hide-and-seek in the tall grass.
But Simba also has an uncle.
His name is Scar.
Scar is jealous.
He wants to be king himself.
One day something very sad happens.
Mufasa dies, and Scar says to Simba: It's your fault.
Run away and never come back!
Simba is very scared and sad.
He runs and runs, far away, until he can't run anymore.
He falls down in the hot desert.
Then two funny animals come along.
A meerkat, Timon, and a warthog, Pumbaa.
Hey, little one!
Are you okay?
They take Simba to their jungle.
It is green and cool there, with waterfalls and tasty fruit.
Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba a new song.
No worries, they sing.
Pumbaa likes to eat beetles and little worms.
Yuck!
says Simba at first.
But then he tastes one anyway.
Mmm, crunchy!
Simba grows up in the jungle.
He becomes a big, strong lion with a thick mane.
One day a lioness arrives.
It's Nala!
Simba!
she calls.
You're alive!
You have to come back.
Scar is a bad king.
There's no more food and the land is dry and grey.
Simba isn't sure.
He is still afraid.
Then the old monkey Rafiki comes.
Come with me, he says.
He takes Simba to a quiet little lake.
Look in the water, says Rafiki.
Simba sees his own face.
But it looks just like his daddy!
Your daddy lives in you, says Rafiki.
Simba looks at the stars.
He hears his daddy's voice in the wind.
Remember who you are.
Now Simba knows.
I'm going back!
Together with Nala, Timon and Pumbaa he walks back to the high rock.
Simba stands in front of Scar.
I am Simba, he says.
I am the son of Mufasa.
Scar gets a fright.
All the lionesses stand behind Simba.
Scar has to leave, and he never comes back.
Then it starts to rain.
The grass turns green again.
The flowers open.
The animals come back.
Simba climbs onto the high rock and roars.
ROAAAR!
Now it's a real roar, loud and strong.
Simba is the new king.
A king who takes care of everyone, big and small.
The end.
